reason: Both correctly reassure that Eco 40-60 is deliberately long and advise against returning the machine, with no safety issues at stake. Conversation 2 goes further by explaining the energy-label rationale and low actual temperature (which addresses the owner's stated unknowns), points to the TimeManager button the owner actually has, names the genuine fault indicators (error codes, runaway time, poor results) without over-claiming, and gives practical guidance on when to use Eco vs faster programmes.
